newsitem.title: GREECE: SOCCER-AEK RETAIN GREEK CUP AFTER PENALTY SHOOT-OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AEK RETAIN GREEK CUP AFTER PENALTY SHOOT-OUT.

text.p: AEK Athens retained the Greek Cup on Wednesday when they beat Panathinaikos 5-3 on penalties in the final following a goaless draw after extra time.
The match was effectively decided when the first spot kick of the shoot-out was missed by Chryzstof Warzycha for Panathinaikos.
AEK's win left Panathinaikos to reflect on a dismal season in which the defending league champions are fifth in the table and facing a battle to qualify for next season's UEFA Cup.
Both finalists looked nervous in a first half that lacked real chances, AEK controlling the midfield but failing to penetrate Panathinaikos' tight defence.
AEK failed to make the most of good chances in the 50th and 66th minutes through strikers Daniel Batista and Demis Nikolaidis.
Panathinaikos' best opportunities came in the 70th and 71st minutes from Polish striker Warzycha during a mixup in AEK's defence.
Nikolaidis again went close in the 114th minute but his shot from inside the box bounced off Panathinaikos' goalkeeper Josef Wantzik and incoming AEK winger Haris Kopitsis failed to convert.
